ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels (central lobes) and 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels (peduncle insertion and trailing edge margins).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions on the medial and distal surfaces of both lobes. Dark pigmentation is concentrated in a wedge at the central notch and as irregular mottling along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (3-7 pixel variations) along the entire trailing edge; several larger irregular notches (peaks) are visible on the right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to slightly upward-sweeping and tapered lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent clusters of high-contrast, raised white barnacle colonies on the far-left and far-right lobe tips. A distinct circular scar (rosette) is visible on the lower-medial white region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible dark, sub-parallel linear rake marks (at least 3-4 distinct lines) oriented diagonally on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular scar on lower-inner right lobe; heavy barnacle colonization on both lateral tips resulting in irregular contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive fine dark mottling and speckling localized along the transition boundary between the white central lobes and the black trailing edge.
